errors.evidence: The description states the accuracy is around 15% at 2 blanks, but the data point on the plot for 2 blanks is clearly above the 20% grid line, at approximately 22%.
The description states the accuracy is about 5% at 4 blanks, but the plot shows the value is much lower, at approximately 1%.
The description claims the accuracy levels off at around 2.5% for 5 and 6 blanks, but the plot shows the data points are at or very near 0%.
